      title: Problem Detail

      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'

          title: Title

          example: NoResourceFoundException

        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true

          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

      required:
        - message

## Summary

I implemented the `ownerSegment` derived field following the project's existing pattern for read-time derived values (like `locality`, `membershipLevel`, `timezone`).

**New logic** — `rest/function/common/OwnerSegments.java`:
- `TIER` = `PREMIUM` when `membershipLevel >= 3`, else `STANDARD` (using the stored level, falling back to `Membership.levelOf(owner)` — mirroring how the mapper resolves `membershipLevel`).
- `AREA` = `METRO` when the owner's locality (`CustomerCodes.localityOf`) is a known region (`NSW`, `VIC`, `QLD`), else `REGIONAL`.
- Returns `<TIER>_<AREA>`.

**Wiring**:
- `OwnerMapper.java` — imported `OwnerSegments` and added `@Mapping(target = "ownerSegment", expression = "java(OwnerSegments.of(owner))")`.
- `openapi.yml` — added the read-only `ownerSegment` string field to the `Owner` schema (so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it), documenting all four values and the TIER/AREA rules.

**Tests** — `OwnerSegmentTests.java` exercises all four segments end-to-end via `POST /api/owners` + `GET`: `STANDARD_REGIONAL`, `STANDARD_METRO`, `PREMIUM_METRO`, and `PREMIUM_REGIONAL` (the last two via a 3-member household whose third member reaches level 3).

No `@RestController`/Spring MVC was introduced — the change stays within the derived-field mapping layer, consistent with AGENTS.md.
